CustomField.description: When true, GtmReadoutController.selfApproveReadout lets a readout's own owner approve it directly, bypassing the GTM_Readout_Approval ApprovalProcess entirely and logging the action to GTM_Readout_Approval_Log__c instead. When false (default), the existing manager-approval ApprovalProcess path is the only way to approve.
CustomField.label: Self Approval Enabled
